phone.title: Use your phone
phone.body: Photos work best on the camera you hold.
phone.qrAlt: QR code to open verification on your phone
phone.hint: On a phone already? Allow camera access and reopen this page.

start.title: Get Verified

consent.line3: Images delete 7 days after decision. Withdraw here anytime.

start.agree: I agree to identity review for the Verified badge.

capture.cameraDenied: The camera is blocked for this site. Allow it in your browser settings, then try again.
capture.checksBypassed: We could not read the checks. A reviewer decides.

quality.line: Line the card up inside the frame.
quality.blurry: Hold still. Text must be sharp.

selfie.initial: Bring your face into the oval.
selfie.unavailable: Face guidance is off. Keep your face centred and well lit.
selfie.noFace: No face yet. Bring it into the oval.
selfie.closer: A bit closer — fill more of the oval.
selfie.center: Centre up — chin inside the oval.
selfie.allPassed: All checks passed. Capture your selfie.
selfie.challengeExpired: The selfie check expired. Please retake your selfie.

review.title: Check photos
review.nameHint: Your profile name will match your ID.

dispute.duplicate: This ID is already verified on another Draazy account.
dispute.sheetBody: Tell us if this ID is yours.
dispute.sent: Report sent. Our team will reply within 2 working days.
dispute.open: You already have an open report.

status.pendingBody: We will update the badge after review.
status.revokedBody: Your Verified badge is no longer active.

withdraw.title: Remove ID data?
withdraw.body: This deletes your documents, selfie and badge.

rejection.blurry: Photo was blurry. Retake in brighter light.
rejection.cropped: Corners were cut off. Keep the full ID inside the frame.
rejection.mismatch: Details did not match. Use your own ID.
rejection.expired: Document is expired. Try a valid one.
rejection.not_holder: Selfie did not match the ID holder.
rejection.other: Review could not approve this. Try again.
rejection.not_reviewed: Review timed out. This does not use an attempt.

errors.unreachable: That did not send. Check your connection and try again.
errors.updated: Draazy was updated while this page was open. Reload and start again.
errors.server: Verification is unavailable right now — this is on our side, not your photos. Please try again later{{reference}}.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again later.
errors.rateLimitedWithRetry: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}}s.
errors.alreadyRegistered: This ID is already verified on another Draazy account.
errors.disputeOpen: You already have an open report.
errors.disputeConflict: Please try submitting your document again first.
errors.invalidNumber: Check the ID number and try again.
errors.genericClient: That did not work. Check the details and try again.
